title: The lost sandal
text:
Dewi went to the beach with her uncle. She played in the waves and built a sandcastle.

When it was time to go home, Dewi looked for her sandals. She found one, but the other one was gone.

"Where is it?" she asked. Uncle Joko looked behind a rock. Dewi looked under her towel. They could not find it.

Then a small girl came running. "Is this yours?" she asked. She was holding a blue sandal. A wave had carried it away, and the girl had found it in the sand.

"Thank you!" said Dewi. She felt very grateful.
